Minimum Structured Content: Report title; type; organization; author; period; date; project/program; audience
Goal/outcome/output/activity results; indicators; baseline; target; actual; variance; evidence
Reach; sex/age/disability or other lawful program-relevant disaggregation; accessibility
Approved budget; expenditure; variance; explanation; restricted-fund implications
PSEAH/protection/duty-of-care summary without unnecessary identifying case information
Data source; quality; verification; monitoring/evaluation method
Challenges; corrective actions; decisions; owners; deadlines
Supporting tables/files; evidence links; financial schedules; participant-safe media
